title: 🌊 Flowing Circles Animation with JavaScript Canvas 🎨
description:
🌊 Flowing Circles Animation with JavaScript Canvas 🎨

I’ve built a mesmerizing Flowing Circles Animation using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript! This project creates a dynamic visual effect where colorful circles flow across the screen with a soothing wave-like motion, leaving fading trails behind them. It’s lightweight, customizable, and perfect for adding some flair to your website! 🚀

  • What’s it about? A canvas-based animation featuring circles that move horizontally, oscillate vertically, and fade into trails for a 3D-like perspective effect.

  • The result? A smooth, eye-catching animation that feels alive and immersive.

  • Main key of the code: The Circleclass handles movement, wave oscillation Math.sin), and trail effects, while the animation loop requestAnimationFrame) ensures fluid rendering.

  • How can users benefit? Add it to your site as a background, tweak the number of circles, speed, or colors to match your vibe, or use it as a creative coding playground!
shortDescription: 🌟 A flowing circle animation with trails and wave motion, built with JS Canvas. Perfect for backgrounds or creative projects!
